additional_info.subject: RE: ID0373777-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R4 170001711] OCPP Offline CRM:01811000215
additional_info.body:
Hello team,
hope this message finds you well.
I wanted to update you on the issue regarding the charger going offline due to a poor network connection. We have taken steps to address this by upgrading our router to a 4G connection. However, to ensure the stability and reliability of the charger's connection, we believe it would be beneficial to test the charger with a different SIM card.
Testing the charger with a different SIM card will help us determine if the issue is specific to the current SIM card or if there are other factors. This process will allow us to pinpoint the root cause of the connectivity problem and implement the necessary solutions to ensure seamless operation.
Please inform us if you require any assistance on-site.
Thank you for your continued support and patience as we work to resolve this issue promptly.
Best regards
,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
